system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: From 13:32:41 through 13:47:38 UTC, FILE-NWD-01 repeatedly logged network logon failures for svc-render at roughly one-minute intervals. The events identify lsass.exe, source address 10.40.20.20, and status subcode 0xc000006a.
The domain controller also recorded failed svc-render authentication attempts attributed to FILE-NWD-01, including NTLM status 0xc000006a and Kerberos pre-authentication status 0x18.

The recurring failures from FILE-NWD-01 are consistent with the inventory-described RenderQueue job re-authenticating each minute after the scheduled svc-render password rotation, but these records do not establish that the job caused them.

At 13:36:09 UTC, WS-NBLAKE-01 recorded a PowerShell process running as SYSTEM using explicit credentials for svc-render with PROXY-NWD-01 as the target. This activity is not explained by the supplied inventory context, but the record does not show whether authentication succeeded or why it occurred.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records cover 13:32:41 through 13:47:38 UTC; they do not provide authentication activity for the full requested 13:20–14:20 UTC interval.
The records do not include evidence identifying the process or job configuration associated with FILE-NWD-01 PID 0x1684.
The 4648 record documents explicit-credential use, but does not establish successful authentication or the surrounding PowerShell command and user activity (T042-00009).
claims_not_established: Whether the svc-render password rotation occurred as scheduled and whether RenderQueue was updated afterward.
Whether the failed attempts were caused by the expected RenderQueue job or by another process.
Whether the explicit svc-render credential use from WS-NBLAKE-01 was authorized, successful, or malicious.
Whether there were successful or otherwise relevant authentication events outside the supplied records.
additional_evidence_needed: Obtain authentication and proxy logs for the full 13:20–14:20 UTC window, including any successful svc-render logons and the outcome of the WS-NBLAKE-01-to-PROXY-NWD-01 activity.
Collect WS-NBLAKE-01 PowerShell, process, and endpoint telemetry around 13:36 UTC to identify the command, initiating activity, and session context.
Collect FILE-NWD-01 process and service/job telemetry for PID 0x1684 and RenderQueue, plus records confirming the password rotation and job update.
Verify with the responsible administrators whether the svc-render credential use from WS-NBLAKE-01 was authorized.
